## History

Phillips obtained his teaching position as Avonlea's schoolmaster because his uncle was a trustee, and he boarded at Eben Wright's house. During his time as master, he disciplined [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) for her temper by forcing her to stand in front of the blackboard and later making her sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). At the end of his term, Phillips departed from the school, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in tears despite her mixed feelings toward him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as Prissy's school mentor while actively pursuing a romantic connection with her. He courts her using complimentary language and gifts of flowers. Their bond combines an academic mentorship with open, personal courtship.
